description: This file defines the 'Selections' class and its nested classes, which manage different selection states and interactions within a navigation editor UI, including component selection, root component movement, and relation (connection) handling.

classes.name: Selections
classes.description: Main class managing different selection states in the navigation editor, including empty, component, root component, and relation selections.

classes.name: Selections.Selection
classes.description: Abstract base class for different selection types, defining core interaction methods.

classes.name: Selections.EmptySelection
classes.description: Represents an inactive or null selection state.

classes.name: Selections.ComponentSelection
classes.description: Handles selection and rendering of UI components within the navigation editor.

classes.name: Selections.AndroidRootComponentSelection
classes.description: Specialized selection for Android root components, supporting movement and snapping.

classes.name: Selections.RelationSelection
classes.description: Manages the creation and visualization of relations (transitions) between components.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the selection to a specified location; varies by subclass.

methods.name: finaliseSelectionLocation
methods.description: Finalizes the selection at a given location, often creating or confirming a transition.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Renders the selection visuals on the graphics context.

methods.name: paintOver
methods.description: Paints overlay visuals for the selection.
